@{63aef086871aaf343e0fc87f|full_name}: I would absolutely love this. Myself and a few friends like to set our home instance to public to immediately jump into public lobbies upon opening the game, this seems like a perfect extension of that.

Being able to "come home" to your "family" of friends/group members in VR would such a cool and cozy experience. I'd even say that if this were to be implemented it'd be one of my favourite additions to VRChat.

comments.mergedPostDetails: I hope to add a 'group's home' feature, which allows members of a group to automatically join the group's home when entering the game. This feature should be optional, meaning that without any specific configuration, players will still return to their default homes/player-set homes. However, there should be an option in the settings to choose whether the default home is the 'group's home.' Additionally, the 'group's world' setting should be adjustable by the owner and individuals with appropriate permissions.

We recently obtained a setting to change our home world to public or friends+ or friends instead of private.

I'd like to be able to set my home world to a particularly group setting with saved configurable options.

Good evening,

I contacted you by email but I was asked to send you my message here

I would like to contact you to propose a very interesting idea for the groups on VRChat.

You could propose a "homeworld" in common with all the members of the same group, this will give a higher interest to your subscription.

Many friends agree with my idea and would like to see it in place.

By hoping to help you, and continue to see your game grow!

I look forward to answering your questions.

Good luck.

My ID : Roi Grillbad

ps : sorry for my bad english, i'm french :)
Allow home instance to be opened as a group instance.

Due to the announcement of the new group feature. I think groups should be able to set up a home world for their groups, so that members can start the game up and instantly load into an instance with them. Depending on how the group feature actually works (I would assume you have to set a “main” group and then be able to have side groups to join/follow. Your main group would be the group home that you spawn into. As for how it would determine what instance to set you, I think the best way would be to dedicate an instance number to that group, so that it would allow them to join the instance. Hope this idea finds its way to be included into the group feature.

Fantastic to have the new instance options, but there's one more addition I feel is a must have, and that would be group hubs.

Similar to how setting a home world works, it could be something a group owner, or mods, could set for the group itself as a sort of official world.

Then the players could choose between spawning in a home world or spawning in the group hub of which ever group they're representing.
Groups have a home world, either one that they visit a lot or one set by the leader or a 2/3 vote. I have attached a very rough drawing of what it would look like.

comments.value: It's a shame there's still no option for this yet, not even a marking to show they're interested 😩
Sounds like the devs finally caught interest in the idea as of the most recent update vid \o/

details:
Group owners (or users with appropriate permission) would be able to set a private or publicly listed world as that groups "Homeworld", so whenever people log on they all end up in the same instance. There would be a button to directly join the instance also in the group page.

My friendsgroup have been using steam launch parameters for a very long time to do this, and I think it's awesome to just log on and see my friends without having to dash out invites.
title: Shared Group Homeworld
